hard_rules: Imported corpora never become sovereign authority by default.
Historical task notes do not become live queue entries without fresh bounded rewrite.
Archive and prototype material must pass through summary or dossier form before execution planning.
Client delivery work must remain anchored to the client portfolio surfaces.
Runtime queue and strategic ledger remain separate.
purpose: Define how external memory enters Annunimas without becoming a second authority.

states.meaning: Memory is preserved for context and reading only.
Material has been curated into readable Annunimas surfaces.
Imported memory has a current anchor and bounded project identity.

forbidden_surfaces: direct queue execution without explicit review
states.meaning: A bounded implementation or execution plan exists.
The project has passed intake law, dossier quality, and review posture.

transition_rules: summary_promoted -> dossier_ready requires current anchor plus owner
dossier_ready -> plan_ready requires bounded next actions
plan_ready -> execution_eligible requires explicit review and readiness confirmation
